svg.title: Continuity and linearity of c Wv transfer (TL3) to complex differentiability of Fv. Finite-dimensional complex analysis makes it holomorphic on the full open tube. At this point no spectral support assertion is needed for holomorphy itself; the support condition will make the result independent of the cutoff.
